name: kidney_exchange_10_0.4_fz
note: published: https://github.com/hakank/hakank/blob/master/minizinc/kidney_exchange_10_0.4_fz.dzn. That file lists for each person p the donors who can give to p; transposed here to the description's form (compatible[i] = people i can donate to). The optimum is the same either way, since the solutions are disjoint cycles
